name: Potassium metabisulphite
why_its_added: Stops browning and slows microbes in dried fruit, juices and some drinks.

india.note: FSSAI sets these limits for the SULPHITES family as a whole, not for this one substance. Maximum level depends on the food. Examples below.

eu.note: EFSA has assessed the safety of this additive, but we have no public record of its current authorisation in the EU.

eu_safety_opinion.title: Scientific Opinion on the re-evaluation of sulfur dioxide -E 220-, sodium sulfite -E 221-, sodium bisulfite -E 222-, sodium metabisulfite -E 223-, potassium metabisulfite -E 224-, calcium sulfite -E 226-, calcium bisulfite -E 227- and potassium bisulfite -E 228- as food additives

safe_daily_limit.unit: mg per kg of body weight per day

means: No single-serving limit has been found for this substance. That is not the same as there being no risk from one large serving - it means nobody has published a number.

people_reports.rule: Reports are shown as reports. We count them. We never turn them into a health claim, and we never let them change the sourced facts above.
